purpose: Register the Stage 6-6 consumed-input semantic projections required to prevent false semantic equality when the Stage 6-6 manifest summary remains stable but consumed Soldier or relation payload changes.
reasonForExtension: P3 demonstrated that the P1 Stage 6-6 manifest projection alone cannot represent combat/ability/training/SP payload values because those values are not embedded in the Stage 6-6 manifest. The P1 core classification contract remains unchanged; this subordinate registry adds only Stage 6-6-local source projection identities.

fullRecords.ordering: records normalized by soldierId because Stage 6-6 consumes them through ID indexes

relationSet.ordering: edges normalized by heroId then soldierId; sourceKind list normalized lexicographically
relationSet.scope: Stage 6-6-local relation consumption only; does not replace the broader hero-soldier-relation/semantic-v1 projection for provenance-sensitive consumers

excludedByConstruction: unconsumed identity/display fields such as nameKr in the fullRecords source projection

migration.stickyProvenance: When the registered semantic digest is unchanged, preserve the previously frozen gitBlobSha so metadata-only upstream churn does not rewrite the Stage 6-6 frozen artifact. When semantics change, advance the frozen provenance SHA with the new digest.

forbidden: Use this Stage 6-6-local relation projection as a replacement for broader relation semantic authority
Treat nameKr as globally non-semantic; it is excluded here only because Stage 6-6 does not consume it
Drop existing Stage 6-6 semantic checks or baselines
Change workflow transport or Project Doctor policy in P3
completion: P3 source projections are complete when Stage 6-6 can distinguish provenance-only source churn from consumed semantic changes while preserving all existing Stage 6-6 semantic validations and exact-diff determinism after the one-time migration freeze.
